headline.note: The Lean theorem states both bounds from a threshold on m, as Theorem 1 of the expert companion does. pivot.note: The sampler gives the successful-index law of the displayed preparation, but it skips the remaining comparisons after a failed one, so it does not build the full tensor state; a separate Lean theorem constructs that state. promise-gap.note: The analytic distributions can sample off-promise inputs. A difference in means alone does not establish the promised decision-tree lower bound.
